# A constant limit, for i := 0; i < 4; i++, is rewritten with the limit spelled out.
# Slices shorter than the limit panic, even when their capacity is larger.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Saxpy4(a float32, x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		y[i] += a * x[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func Saxpy4(a float32, x, y []float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(a)
	_ = y[4-1]
	_ = x[4-1]
	for _i := 0; _i < 4; {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:4])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(y[_i:4])
		_v1.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v2).StorePart(y[_i:4])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func try(f func()) (panicked bool) {
	defer func() { panicked = recover() != nil }()
	f()
	return
}

func main() {
	x := []float32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}
	y := []float32{10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60}
	test.Saxpy4(2, x, y)
	fmt.Println(y)
	long := make([]float32, 3, 10)
	fmt.Println(try(func() { test.Saxpy4(2, x, long) }), try(func() { test.Saxpy4(2, x[:3], y) }))
}
-- testmain/output --
[12 24 36 48 50 60]
true true
